task_description: Write a method in Dafny to join an array of multiple integers into a single integer.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method JoinIntegers(a: array<int>) returns (result: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The result is the concatenation of all integers in the input array in order
    - The result represents a valid integer formed by joining the array elements as strings
    - The length of the result corresponds to the total number of digits of all array elements combined
